steps.content: When Norma opens her eyes again, she is standing on a stone path.
On either side, shrubs grow thick and green. Low timber-and-stone houses bear iron signs, and a Gothic spire pierces the distance. It is nothing like the Bureau, let alone modern society.
Norma stands frozen, gazing down at the laptop in her hands. She nudges her glasses up and calls up her earlier movement log.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: ...Four attempts to leave. Each time, I end up right back here.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: The environment reads normal. Until I have a verifiable conclusion, panic is meaningless.

Not long ago, Norma arrived at the Bureau as a forensic specialist dispatched from the Public Security Bureau to lend support. She had only just deployed several environmental-data monitoring models when a powerful disturbance surged through the air. A glance up, a blink, and the world was reshaped into this.
She lifts her head and scans her surroundings. An elf in a pointed hat flicks a hand, and a fireball bursts to life on a roadside lamppost.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: The energy conversion pathway is unclear. But the flame is real.
Norma blinks. The physical parameters that usually render clearly in her vision are now twisted by some unknown force in this world, spiking into grotesquely inflated values.
Soon enough, the screen erupts with searing error codes and warning pop-ups.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: As expected, the <color=#fb9259>M-value</color> is the only outlier.
Norma lets her eyelids fall, untroubled. Nothing seems beyond salvaging just yet.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: ...The monitoring models are still running. The local creatures show no hostile intent, or rather, no interest in me for now. I still have time for a more thorough analy—
Just as she prepares to continue debugging the program, a heavy thud rings out. A large, green, viscous mass drops from above and splats directly onto her laptop screen.
The force nearly knocks Norma off balance, but she keeps a solid grip on the laptop.
The blob writhes over the screen, smearing slime in its wake and emitting sticky, squelching noises. It seems harmless enough, but still, Norma feels her scalp prickle with revulsion.

steps.speaker: Green Blob
steps.content: Squish.
Right on cue, the laptop brings up fresh environmental data.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: ...A slime... formed from Mania?

Norma has never encountered such a readout from the environmental monitoring model before. She's briefly thrown into bewildered silence, but she reins it in at once and settles into a cool, methodical analysis.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: What kind of Mania field generates something like this?

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: And there are also... magical phenomena, slime-like creatures that actively approach humans, a town that looks pulled from a game...
Norma looks toward the distant town, then down at the seemingly adorable green blob that is, in truth, a Mania bomb. Her tone stays utterly flat.

steps.speaker: Green Blob
steps.content: Squish?

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: Communication isn't an option. But I still suggest you get off my laptop immediately.
It doesn't move off. Instead, it shuffles toward the middle of the screen, squarely obscuring the warning: "Advised to maintain distance from this creature."
Normally, Norma would follow protocol and stay clear of Mania.
But the Norma standing here is ready to probe for deeper, stranger laws.
She acts decisively, reaching out and grabbing the slime, her palm registering its cool, slick surface.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: Conventional methods have all failed. Then... time for a different variable.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: Initiating... fifth spatial exploration attempt.
Expressionless, Norma squeezes harder. The moment the green blob distorts, she triggers her ability, skipping past the physical values and forcing a direct touch on the Mania within.

steps.speaker: Green Blob
steps.content: Squiiiish!!!
The slime thrashes in her grip, convulsing through countless shapes, then—crack—it reverts to its raw Mania state, transforming into a spatial rift that swallows Norma whole.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: The switch has a nice feel to it.
